CubeEvil4 fork - permanent signing key backup
============================================
Created 2026-11-16 for the repository Tim-ui-boop/CE4-fork.

KEEP THIS FILE PRIVATE. Anyone holding it can sign an APK that Android
accepts as an update of your installed app.

It is already stored in the repository's Actions secrets, so CI uses it
automatically. This file is a backup in case those secrets are ever lost:
without the key, no future build can update an installed app and you would
have to uninstall once more.

Store password : IAtoGCwWrVYbHzZwE6dB7fwkULpxvOv4
Key password   : IAtoGCwWrVYbHzZwE6dB7fwkULpxvOv4

To restore the CI secrets from this file, base64-decode the block below
into re4.jks and set these four repository secrets:
  RE4_KEYSTORE_BASE64    = the base64 block (one line)
  RE4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD  = the store password above
  RE4_KEY_ALIAS          = re4
  RE4_KEY_PASSWORD       = the key password above
